0. Load Libraries and functions & set working directory:
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

# Data Functions for loading raw FFI output data
# Header loading function
load_headers <- function(directory_path, pattern) {
  list_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  data_list <- lapply(list_files, function(file) {
    file_data <- read.csv(file) %>% select(1:10) %>% filter(Visited == "True")
    file_data <- file_data %>% mutate(Comment = "")
  })
  return(do.call(rbind, data_list))
}

load_data <- function(directory_path, pattern) {
  list_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  data_list <- lapply(list_files, function(file) {
    if (file.info(file)$size == 0) return(NULL)
    file_data <- tryCatch({
      read.csv(file, skip = 3) %>% mutate(Comment = "")
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error reading file: ", file, " - skipping this file.")
      return(NULL)
    })
    return(file_data)
  })
  do.call(rbind, data_list[!sapply(data_list, is.null)])
}
  
directory_path <- "C:/Users/cfossum/OneDrive - DOI/Desktop/ROMOFX/FFI Data - WORKING/Fall26rx/"
```

1. Cover 
```{r}
cover_df <- load_data(directory_path, "_Cover - Points \\(metric\\)\\.csv$")
list <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "_Cover - Points \\(metric\\)\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)   
cover_headers <- lapply(list, function(file) read.csv(file, nrows = 1))
cover_headers <- do.call(rbind, cover_headers)  
cover_df <- left_join(x = cover_df, y = cover_headers, by = c("MacroPlot.Name", "Sample.Event.Date")) 
#to see unique plot names, type in "unique(Xdf$MacroPlot.Name) into console
cover_df <- cover_df %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP001" ~ "RAP_01", 
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP002" ~ "RAP_02",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP003" ~ "RAP_03",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP004" ~ "RAP_04",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP006" ~ "RAP_06",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP007" ~ "RAP_07",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP008" ~ "RAP_08",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP009" ~ "RAP_09",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP010" ~ "RAP_10",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP011" ~ "RAP_11",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "BME_RAP012" ~ "RAP_12",
                                                 TRUE ~ MacroPlot.Name))%>%select(-MacroPlot.Name) 

cover_df <- cover_df %>% mutate(PlotStatus = case_when(startsWith(Sample.Event.Date, "2024") ~ "PreBurn", TRUE ~ NA_character_))
cover_df <- cover_df %>% select(c(Plot, PlotStatus, Tape, Transect, Point, Order, Species, Height, Status, Comment.x, Num..Transects, Tran..Length, Num..Pts..Tran.))

  
write.csv(seedling_df, "C:/Users/cfossum/OneDrive - DOI/Desktop/ROMOFX/DataAnalysis/Data_Clean/Fall26RX/fall26rx_pre_COVER.csv")
```

6. Trees Report
```{r}
trees_report <- read.csv("Data - Working/BMrx//Report_TreesbySpecies_E.csv", skip = 2)
trees_report <- trees_report %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:01" ~ "PIPS_01", 
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:02" ~ "PIPS_02",
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:05" ~ "PIPS_05",
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:14" ~ "PIPS_14", TRUE ~ Macroplot ))%>%select(-Macroplot)

trees_report <- trees_report %>% select(c(Plot, MonStatus, Species, Individuals, Snag, Total, BA, LiCrBHt, Height, QMD, CrScPct, ScorchHt,CharHt))

trees_report <- trees_report %>% slice(c(1:14, 32:34, 45:47, 58:60))

trees_report <- trees_report %>% mutate(PlotStatus = case_when(MonStatus == "02PRE" | MonStatus == "01PRE" ~ "PreBurn", MonStatus == "03POST" | MonStatus == "02POST" ~ "PostBurn", MonStatus == "03YR01" | MonStatus == "02YR01" ~ "Year01"))

trees_report <- trees_report %>% select(c(Plot, PlotStatus, Species, Individuals, Snag, Total, BA, LiCrBHt, Height, QMD, CrScPct, ScorchHt,CharHt))

write.csv(trees_report, "Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/fall25rx_pre_post_year01_TREESREPORT.csv")

```
